description: This file exports functions, types, and helpers related to SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) mitigation, including network-related utilities, policy-building functions, and error formatting for the SSRF runtime in the project's plugin SDK.

methods.name: closeDispatcher
methods.description: Closes the SSRF dispatcher, releasing associated resources.

methods.name: createPinnedDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a dispatcher that has a pinned (fixed) configuration.

methods.name: isBlockedHostnameOrIp
methods.description: Determines if a hostname or IP address is blocked according to SSRF policies.

methods.name: resolvePinnedHostname
methods.description: Resolves a pinned hostname to its network address.

methods.name: resolvePinnedHostnameWithPolicy
methods.description: Resolves a hostname considering specific SSRF policies.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats error messages for SSRF-related errors.

methods.name: fetchWithSsrFGuard
methods.description: Performs a fetch operation with SSRF guard protections.

methods.name: assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork
methods.description: Asserts that HTTP URL targets are within private networks for security.

methods.name: buildHostnameAllowlistPolicyFromSuffixAllowlist
methods.description: Builds an SSRF hostname allowlist policy from a suffix allowlist.

methods.name: ssrfPolicyFromAllowPrivateNetwork
methods.description: Creates an SSRF policy allowing private network access.

methods.name: isPrivateOrLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is in a private or loopback network.
